title: Air Pollution Predictor Commons
text: goal appc package provide daily, high resolution, near real-time, model-based ambient air pollution exposure assessments. achieved training generalized random forest several geomarkers predict daily average EPA AQS concentrations 2017 near-present (currently June 2026) exact locations across contiguous United States (see model-performance report details). APPC collects harmonizes EPA AQS outcomes handles model development, evaluation, prediction. geomarker package supplies environmental predictors. Model generation 3 uses geomarker 0.2.0, coverage January 1, 2017 June 30, 2026. trained 618,918 daily observations 786 EPA AQS locations. Daily leave-one-location-cross-validation gives median absolute error 1.20 micrograms per cubic meter median Spearman correlation 0.84. See model-performance report full evaluation, including interval coverage. trained model, training dataset, checksums, provenance paired model generation 3 release. predict_pm25() downloads verifies model first use; model/data release must published download available. v2 release evaluation cover dates. Aggregate cross-validation performance similar, slightly different observations refreshed EPA data.

title: appc 3.0.0
text: Require terra 1.9.46 newer compressed NetCDF extraction fix, allow completed AQS refreshes reused options(appc.refresh_aqs = FALSE). Retry transient EPA API failures resume incomplete AQS refreshes harmonized state checkpoints without replacing last complete annual extract. Include Idaho North Dakota AQS API refreshes complete contiguous-US coverage. predict_pm25() now accepts geomarker s2cd objects directly, using stored dates retaining existing list--tibbles output. Release model generation 3 January 2017 June 2026 using geomarker 0.2.0, pinned release commit 373820d0ab8082f856f7bf0f639f3128111d825a. Share geomarker-backed predictor assembly committed training-data script prediction, preserving input location/date order duplicates. Keep AQS outcome harmonization existing GRF training specification. Remove standalone environmental assessment installation APIs; use geomarker functions. Elevation now comes USGS 3DEP rather v2 PRISM source, v2 model reused inputs. Record model generation separately package version, preserve training provenance, require matching metadata local v3 model artifacts. Distribute trained forest 618,918-row training dataset together rf_pm_v3, checksums exact model/data provenance. Retain January 2017 June 2026 date range used v2. Daily LOLO median absolute error 1.20 micrograms per cubic meter median Spearman correlation 0.84, matching reported v2 values. Median coverage reported 95% intervals 69% (v2: 70%). Refreshed EPA outcomes add 7,346 observations three locations relative v2, evaluation rows differ.
